events.name: Free Flu Vaccinations
events.note: Its walk in, first come first serve and we have only 60 counts.
events.description: Flu season is here, and we're making it easy to stay protected. Join our free on-site flu vaccination clinic on 16th June, 10 am  -4pm. A qualified nurse/pharmacist will be on hand, and each jab takes just a few minutes — drop in any time, no booking needed. Getting vaccinated is the best way to protect yourself, your colleagues, and those around you this season. Please wear short sleeves for easy access, and let the vaccinator know of any allergies or if you've been feeling unwell. Questions? Contact Devbhoomi Charitable Trust
